title: Notification regarding Single Bench Vacation Court with the following Hon'ble Judges to take up urgent matters during the ensuring Summer Vacation .
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Dated the 5th June, 2025
No. HCM/1/96/BENCH/ The Hon’ble Chief Justice is pleased to constitute
Single Bench Vacation court with the following Hon’ble Judges to take up urgent matters during
the ensuing Summer Vacation starting from 21st June, 2025 to 5th July, 2025 as shown below:-
VACATION COURT
Date
25th June, 2025
2nd July, 2025
Hon'ble Judge for Vacation Court
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh
Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma
Further, it is informed that urgent matter pertaining to Civil and Criminal which is sought
to be listed before the Vacation Court may be allowed to be filed till 12:00 Noon of 24th June,
2025 (Tuesday) and lst July, 2025 (Tuesday). They shall be accompanied by separate
applications for urgent listing before the Vacation Court clearly mentioning the reasons for
urgency .
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(KH. A]IT SINGH)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
